task_name: Schema, slot seed, indexes, and idempotent backfill

concerns_addressed: Concern lingkungan: command integration literal memakai server/.env ke localhost:55432 dan gagal (ECONNREFUSED); PostgreSQL aktif di 127.0.0.1:5432 dengan user/database lokal rfxlamia/postgres. Dengan DATABASE_URL eksplisit ke service tersebut, integration PASS. Final disposition: resolved environment/setup concern, not a code defect. The literal no-override command independently passed 2/2 again at 845ca56937580ce44386cccc0764782742eba9fb.

strengths: The final integration fixture is compacted from 529 to 338 lines with no eighth file. In the context of two complete real-PostgreSQL schema branches and retained data-safety coverage, 338 lines is acceptably near the normative ~300-line threshold; all named functions and test callbacks remain at or below approximately 50 lines.

Both schema branches assert exact tracker vocabulary slots for every migrated card. Interleaved human and agent column positions make workspace-only ranking fail, proving null-safe per-board partitioning rather than merely observing a non-null status_id.

Pre-first-backfill snapshots compare column_id and exact PostgreSQL text representations of started_at, done_at, and deleted_at; deleted cards remain keyless while receiving status, filled card and tracker keys remain unchanged, counters advance monotonically, and the complete second application is equal to the first result.

The full T2 SQL retains guarded dynamic board_id handling with no parse-time optional-column reference, nullable additive slot/card columns, five null-only status slot seeds, correct separate card_labels foreign keys, required partial/non-unique indexes, and no card/cross-table key UNIQUE, trigger, timestamp mutation, status NOT NULL, tracker_item_labels reuse, or agent-schema.sql change.

Workspace locking and stable live-null-card iteration allocate consecutive keys after the maximum existing tracker/card key without decrementing the counter or issuing keys to deleted rows; status backfill includes live, soft-deleted, human, and historical agent cards and ignores unslotted statuses.

All three exact packet commands passed at the final reviewed SHA (10/10 static, 7/7 seed, 2/2 real PostgreSQL integration). Root typecheck and lint also passed; lint emitted only the repository's pre-existing graphify file-size warning.
